_doc: The player's body walking, jogging and sprinting, filmed from its right side on the flat ground east of the Cracked Toll. Eight frames 0.1 s apart per gait. Run with --fixed-fps 60 so the interval is simulation time: xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1600x900x24' godot --path game --rendering-driver opengl3 --audio-driver Dummy --resolution 1600x900 --fixed-fps 60 -- --capture=tools/capture/plans/gait.json --out=captures/gait
